gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-khudawad: Heavy, vintage swagger up top, then a lighter hand below. Woodgod throws its weight around in the headline, while Noto Sans Khudawadi, a plain sans, keeps its rounds unlatched and its capitals and lowercase close in height.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-kr: Commanding is how Woodgod comes across, with a wide channel into every bowl and lowercase that nearly touches the capitals. And Noto Sans KR brings the counterweight, its generous curve gaps and big x-height giving the pair real range.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-lao: Noto Sans Lao brings a modern body with an x-height pushed well above the usual, and mouths left open on c, e, and a. Woodgod, vintage and commanding, supplies the bold headline voice that makes Noto Sans Lao feel even lighter.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Approachable and easy on the eye, Noto Sans Lepcha keeps its curves wide open, with lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals. Noto Sans Lepcha then sits under Woodgod's vintage, commanding display letters like a quieter echo.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Approachable and contemporary, Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters with curves that gape wide open beneath the heading. Woodgod's vintage display letters give it a loud partner.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-malayala: Vintage muscle meets a quiet workhorse. Woodgod's wide-channeled bowls and towering lowercase make the strongest impression, while Noto Sans Malayalam, a sans with a dominant middle zone and an openly bent s, holds the line below.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Chunky vintage display letters meet small letters that stand proud, nearly capital-sized, with curves ending in clear daylight. Woodgod leads loudly; Noto Sans Marchen follows quietly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nu: Woodgod's commanding, vintage display letters sit above tall-bodied small letters and a visibly gaping c at any size. Their shared tall lowercase is the link.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-modi: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Modi shows daylight inside every curve. Beneath Woodgod's commanding display letters, it reads smoothly across many lines, since its capitals and lowercase sit close in height.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-mono: Contemporary and professional, Noto Sans Mono spaces its letters so they never bump together, with sturdy tall lowercase and open curves. And beneath Woodgod's commanding vintage heading, running text would feel steady and generous rather than cramped.
